blurb: Danceworks Dance Centre provides a variety of traditional dance classes for all ages starting as young as 2.5 years old. Classes are one hour long and placement is based on age, experience, and technical development. The studio holds an annual recital showcasing student progress and offers a curriculum including ballet, modern, hip-hop, musical theatre, and tumbling.
extraNote: $15 non-refundable registration fee · Tuition automatically drawn monthly September through June · Failed payments incur $20 late fee after 10th of month · No refunds for missed classes; makeups allowed in same style/level · Non-refundable costume deposits of $45 drawn December 1st; final payments February 1st · Costumes average $68 to $80 · Cell phones not allowed in class · Water only allowed in classrooms; no food, soda, or gum
